reviews_5s:
This thing is awesome.

I don't really mess with the mj, but I got this to grind up Ma Huang / Somlata sticks/shrub. Previously I was using a mortar and pestle, which also works pretty great, but it is more labor intensive and more time consuming. I also am pretty sure I wasn't extracting nearly as much with a mortar and pestle as I am now with this thing. The mortar and pestle was already an upgrade from just breaking the sticks and steeping them in to a tea, but this grinder beats them all.

For the photos, I broke it apart in order of how it is assembled to demonstrate what it looks like. In order from top to bottom we have the following;

1) A storage compartment.
2) The top of the grinder teeth, this part is magnetic instead of threaded which is nice to quickly continue loading.
3) The lower grinder teeth, and first coarse filter.
4) The fine mesh screen filter.
5) The collection tray.

It also comes with a little itty-bitty squeegee thing to presumably push more of your fine particles down through the fine mesh screen. Which it works for, I tried it out. I'm glad it's included, but i also found just tapping the grinder against your palm and sifting the coarse contents back and forth generally works pretty well also. I guess depending on how expensive your reagent is, it would be worth using the squeegee to make sure you got every bit of what you were trying to extract.

I don't really use the storage compartment as I will spend a certain amount of time grinding up a batch of twigs, because the storage compartment wouldn't hold enough to be useful. But for people who fw the mj, then I'm sure this is a handy compartment to have.

Extremely happy with t his for my purposes.This grinder is a keeper. It is a keeper because I can tell you its been a year now I use it every other day. But it is a bit of a process. The final grind outcome is exactly what I want. But know this, you will have to stop grinding the Product maybe twice during the process. The product gets compressed and a scrape with my knife I flip the compression product over and proceed. If you over fill it thats fine but the product will compress and the top lid wont mate with the base. A scrap on the outside to the middle solves that. Keep the little magnet in the center clear so the cap will mate with the base. And finally know this. You will have to poke and clear the little holes with a tooth pick after every time you use it. A minute hassle yes but the end grind is worth it. The storage part on top I have never used. This grinder sits on my desk and does not travel so I dont need to store anything in it but it does make the whole thing bigger in my hand and easier to twist. Now I gotta get back to work!!I like the look and feel of this grinder. I've used it for grinding dehydrated wild oregano and onions from my yard, as well as recreational product. It makes the fun stuff fine enough, but not too fine, so it burned quite well.Works pretty dang well. Pleased. Would buy again or give as a gift for sure.I really love the easy use of this product. I like the separate screen areas. I would definitely order again without hesitation.I think this grinder is fantastic. Smooth movementHi All. So I bought this Silver and Gold Grinder from SHUAIYONGLAN because I had already purchased a crank grinder on Amazon however it was very very difficult to grind anything because I have arthritis, and for me it was a challenge, and it was also very hard to disassemble the crank grinder after using it and hard to clean. Enter the 2.5 inch metal grinder from SHUAIYONGLAN. The grinder is very well constructed, there are no plastic parts. It is all good sturdy metal. It is the perfect diameter at 2.5 inches. The top lid of the grinder opens up to a nice stash area to store your nice ground herbs. There is a strong magnet in the center of the top grinding wheel which holds it firmly in place. It grinds effortlessly; a combination of the magnet, the weight of the top and the crushing and grinding action on the razor sharp teeth are a winning combination. The lower grinding surface and the screen surface are protected by the copper ring around their edges. The herbs grind perfectly and the area above the screen that catches the herbs is capable of handling an ample amount of nice ground herbs . The screen does a fine job filtering kief for the bottom container which is spacious. The grinder doesn't get really dirty and also the herb does not stick to the grinder and it is super easy to take apart and wash up. Here is a little tip for you, i always put a light coating of olive oil on the threads on the grinder before i use it. I have been using grinders for at least 20 years. i can honestly say that after using several different metal, acrylic, and plastic grinders through the years nothing compares to this beauty. I hope my review helps you out.
